script_text: Stop, Aries — Saturn has just crossed your Ascendant and the fiery cosmos is demanding a bold new chapter. Mars in Cancer is squaring Saturn in your 1st House, creating intense friction between your emotional instincts and your need to act. This transit activates your 4th House of Home, stirring unresolved family tensions that demand your attention right now. Venus is trining Jupiter in your 4th House, so if you're single, someone from your past or inner circle will reappear with renewed romantic energy. If you're taken, watch for a deep conversation about emotional boundaries at home. Mercury in Leo activates your 5th House of Creativity, opening a financial opportunity tied to a passion project — but hold off committing until mid-month. Avoid impulsive spending driven by emotion; the 8th House of shared resources is volatile right now. Follow so you don't miss tomorrow's reading.
